articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: Michigan Tech’s November 16, 2026 report discusses an October 19 paper. It reports virtually unchanged accuracy after removing 90% of training examples; at 99%, most predictions remained highly accurate. The threefold speed result concerns model training. The university report and accepted paper’s abstract, metadata and status were inspected; full methods, tables, supplements, data and code were not independently checked or reproduced. Random pruning and coverage-based sampling both appear in the abstract. Laboratory, manufacturing, cash and carbon benefits remain unmeasured here.

articles.availability_note: 密歇根理工大学于2026年11月16日报道10月19日论文：删去90%训练样本后准确度几乎不变；删去99%后，多数预测仍高度准确。三倍提速仅指模型训练。本文查阅大学报道及已接收论文的摘要、出版资料与状态，未独立核查或复现全文方法、表格、补充材料、数据和代码。摘要同时讨论随机删减与覆盖取样；实验、制造、金钱与碳排效益仍待测量。

articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: MIT’s November 17, 2026 account describes ongoing interdisciplinary work and observations from an earlier campus report. It supplies no controlled learning-effect estimate. The 67 projects, 31 MIT units and US$5.5 million cover the whole MITHIC initiative since its 2024 launch; roughly a third of projects concern AI, society and humanity. These are neither 67 completed AI trials nor an annual AI budget. The primary report was inspected; the underlying earlier report, datasets and study designs were not independently examined. Proposed courses and cognitive research retain their prospective status.
